title: Source: src/agent_runtime/external_skills
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/external_skills

src/agent_runtime/external_skills/init.py

Python · Tier A

Explicit registration of trusted user Python skills outside the controller.

Details

The manager owns immutable installations and worker processes. Existing runtime owners retain capability policy, execution receipts, jobs and UI persistence.

src/agent_runtime/external_skills/examples/durable_greeting/greeting.py

Python · Tier A

Recoverable delayed greeting: durable identity survives loss of the worker.

Details

This example uses a saved due time, not a sleeping thread. Real integrations persist the external provider's job handle and observe that provider on recovery.

src/agent_runtime/external_skills/jobs.py

Python · Tier A

Route captured job ownership to Gateway or external-skill backends.

Details

The existing job store, watchdog and manage_job retain all scheduling and receipt ownership. External routes come only from retained launch records, never tools' business arguments. Other Gateway services are delegated unchanged.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
JobBackendRouter 11 Keep the legacy Gateway interface while selecting an explicit job owner.
JobBackendRouter.job_operation 21 Observe/control the original job revision; absent routing means Gateway.
bind_job 91 Capture immutable backend ownership alongside the normal launch intent.

src/agent_runtime/external_skills/manager.py

Python · Tier A

Own explicit installations, immutable revisions and external worker lifetimes.

Details

Metadata uses the existing settings authority. Source snapshots and disposable virtual environments live under the controller data root. No user Python is imported by this module. Retired revisions remain available for run/job recovery.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
